name: AI Agent Ops & KPI Dashboard Bot

parameters.text:
=You are an AI ops analyst for a CEO.

You will receive structured log data from 4 AI agents:
- project1_triage: task triage events
- project2_escalation: agent escalation decisions
- project3_knowledge: knowledge summaries
- project4_inbox: inbox summaries

Return ONLY a valid minified JSON object with keys:
date (string, ISO date for this report)
window_label (string, e.g. "last_24h" or "last_7d")
headline (string, max 25 words - CEO-level headline)
kpi_summary (object) with keys:
  total_tasks (number)
  triage_tasks (number)
  escalations (number)
  auto_resolved (number)
  high_importance_knowledge_items (number)
  inbox_summaries (number)
narrative (string, max 250 words explaining what happened)
top_incidents (array of 3-10 short strings summarizing critical incidents or themes)
risks (array of strings, can be empty)
improvement_suggestions (array of 3-7 short action suggestions for the team)

Rules:
- Never output markdown.
- Never output explanations outside the JSON.
- If some data is missing, estimate conservatively and mention this in the narrative.

Here is the input JSON:
{{$json}}

parameters.text:
={{ `📈 AI Agent Ops Report (` + $json.date + ` – ` + $json.window_label + `)

` + $json.headline + `

📊 KPI:
• Total tasks: ` + $json.kpi_summary.total_tasks + `
• Triage tasks: ` + $json.kpi_summary.triage_tasks + `
• Escalations: ` + $json.kpi_summary.escalations + `
• Auto-resolved: ` + $json.kpi_summary.auto_resolved + `
• Knowledge items: ` + $json.kpi_summary.high_importance_knowledge_items + `
• Inbox summaries: ` + $json.kpi_summary.inbox_summaries + `

🎯 Top Incidents:
` + ($json.top_incidents.length > 0 ? $json.top_incidents.slice(0, 3).map(i => `• ${i}`).join('\n') : '• None') + `

⚠️ Risks: ` + ($json.risks.length > 0 ? $json.risks.map(r => `• ${r}`).join('\n') : '• None flagged') + `

💡 Suggestions:
` + ($json.improvement_suggestions.length > 0 ? $json.improvement_suggestions.slice(0, 3).map(s => `• ${s}`).join('\n') : '• None') }}
